courses.title: INTERNSHIP PREPARATION
courses.prereqText: Permission of the Faculty of Arts and Humanities and enrolment in a Major, a Specialization or Honours Specialization in the Faculty of Arts and Humanities with a cumulative average of at least 70% and no failures or academic offenses. Students can apply in their second year but cannot undertake a for-credit internship until at least their third year.

courses.title: INTERNSHIP WORK TERM
courses.prereqText: Permission of the Faculty of Arts and Humanities and registration in Arts and Humanities 3000A/B/Y. Students must be in at least their third year of either a Major, a Specialization or an Honours Specialization in the Faculty of Arts and Humanities, with a cumulative average of at least 70% and no failures.

courses.title: NON-CREDIT PROFESSIONAL INTERNSHIP
courses.prereqText: Registration in a Major or Honours Specialization, or Specialization in the Faculty of Arts and Humanities, with a cumulative average of at least 70% and no failures and approval of the Department and Dean’s Office of the Arts and Humanities.
